biothings.name: palmoplantar keratoderma-esophageal carcinoma syndrome
biothings.definition: An inherited condition characterized by palmoplantar keratoderma and esophageal cancer. The palmoplantar keratoderma usually begins around age 10, and esophageal cancer may form after age 20. This condition is caused by a mutation in the RHBDF2 gene and is inherited in an autosomal dominant pattern. [GARD:0003102, https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5208-3432]
biothings.synonyms: Bennion-Patterson syndrome, Howell-Evans syndrome, keratosis palmoplantaris-esophageal carcinoma syndrome, palmoplantar hyperkeratosis-esophageal carcinoma syndrome, palmoplantar keratoderma-esophageal carcinoma syndrome, tylosis-oesophageal carcinoma syndrome
